text:
maya: quick flag  the rule rail is getting unwieldy for customers with lots of short rules. thinking about a collapse/stack mode that groups small rules into an accordion cluster so the rail doesn't become an endless scroll. :thought_balloon:

samir: sounds promising. cluster by contiguous low-impact rules? we should keep the ability to expand single clusters quickly and still drag items out.

olivia: +1. UX idea: collapsed cluster shows a compact summary row with an expand chevron, a hotspot count, and three small icons for region/model/action. hover/focus reveals the list.

maya: also want a "reorder mode" separate from drag: toggling it reveals large up/down buttons and disables inline edits so accidental moves stop. keyboard users get clear focus styles and aria-live move announcements.

jess: accessibility notes: aria-live should say "Moved 'Rule Name' to position X". when clusters expand/collapse announce "cluster expanded" and list length. ensure contrast and focus management when switching modes.

samir: simulator UX: when rules tie priority and produce different results we currently only show a global toast. propose an inline conflict badge on both rules: small outlined pill "priority conflict" with a tooltip explaining fallback and a quick action to open a resolver UI.

olivia: resolver UI could be a tiny floating editor to set a guard or bump priority without leaving the rail. keep copy short: "Two rules share this priority and return different actions. Make routing deterministic by adding a guard or changing priority."

maya: visual signal idea: add a subtle coverage bar along the left edge of each rule showing percent of simulated traffic hitting that rule. hover shows exact count; footer has a tiny legend. low-contrast by default, and provide aria summary for screen readers.

well-known-deploy-bot: preview-sim: cluster-collapse + coverage-bar deployed to staging. run `preview-sim --policy 77 --samples 400` to see changes. logs: /staging/sim/77

samir: next steps: olivia to mock cluster rows + resolver mini-editor, jess to draft aria announcements and focus flows, maya to finalize conflict pill copy. i'll add acceptance criteria and link in the spec.

olivia: aiming to drop mocks Tue morning.

maya: thanks team!
